meta.business: 金融控股集团：资产管理(BPAM)、汽车租赁(BPTR)、保险(MTWI)

disclaimer.en: This dashboard is prepared for information and educational purposes only from publicly available annual reports. It does not constitute investment advice, an offer, or a solicitation. Figures are rounded to IDR billion; pre-2022 figures include the now-discontinued consumer-finance unit and 2018-2020 continuing revenue is derived by subtracting that segment. Verify against audited financial statements before any decision.
disclaimer.id: Dasbor ini disusun semata-mata untuk informasi dan pendidikan dari laporan tahunan yang tersedia publik. Bukan merupakan nasihat investasi, penawaran, atau ajakan. Angka dibulatkan dalam miliar Rupiah; data pra-2022 masih mencakup unit pembiayaan konsumen yang kini dihentikan, dan pendapatan berjalan 2018-2020 dihitung dengan mengurangi segmen tersebut. Verifikasi ke laporan keuangan audit sebelum mengambil keputusan.
disclaimer.zh: 本看板仅基于公开年报整理，供信息与教育用途，不构成投资建议、要约或招揽。数字以十亿印尼盾取整；2022年以前数据包含已终止的消费金融业务，2018-2020年持续经营收入已扣除该分部。任何决策前请以经审计财务报表为准。

en.d: negative: capex exceeded CFO (fleet + insurance investment)

notes: BPII is a financial holding group; reported 'debt' is dominated by BPTR fleet financing (bank loans) and MTWI insurance contract liabilities, not corporate bonds.
No listed bonds/shariah Sukuk outstanding at the holding company as of FY2025; lender-level breakdown not disclosed at holding level. Bank-loan series shown above.
Insurance contract liabilities (PSAK 117) of ~IDR 3.1 trn at FY2025 are policyholder obligations, not interest-bearing financial debt.

en: Three operating subsidiaries across asset management, fleet leasing, and general insurance provide recurring, non-cyclical revenue streams.
Asset management contributes ~IDR 400bn revenue and IDR 78bn net profit on IDR 49tn AUM.
Fleet and insurance as growth pillars
BPTR fleet 6,928 vehicles; MTWI gross written premium IDR 1,695.8bn, both scaling steadily.
id: Tiga anak usaha di manajemen investasi, sewa armada, dan asuransi umum memberikan pendapatan berulang non-siklus.
Manajemen investasi menyumbang ~Rp400 miliar pendapatan dan Rp78 miliar laba bersih dari AUM Rp49 triliun.
Armada dan asuransi sebagai pilar tumbuh
Armada BPTR 6.928 kendaraan; premi bruto MTWI Rp1.695,8 miliar, keduanya tumbuh stabil.

terms.x: Assets Under Management — total client money managed by BPAM (in IDR trillion).
PT Batavia Prosperindo Aset Manajemen — BPII asset management / mutual fund subsidiary.
PT Batavia Prosperindo Trans Tbk — BPII listed car rental / fleet management subsidiary (IDX: BPTR).
PT Malacca Trust Wuwungan Insurance Tbk — BPII listed general insurance subsidiary (IDX: MTWI).
Gross Written Premium — total insurance premium written before reinsurance ceding.
Return on Equity — net profit divided by average shareholders equity, expressed as a percentage.
Return on Assets — net profit divided by average total assets.
Debt-to-Equity ratio — total liabilities divided by total equity.
Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation and Amortisation — core operating profitability measure.
Free Cash Flow — operating cash flow minus capital expenditure.
Otoritas Jasa Keuangan — Indonesia Financial Services Authority, regulator of all three subsidiaries.
Sum-of-the-parts valuation — valuing each subsidiary separately and summing.
Book Value Per Share — total equity divided by shares outstanding.
Earnings Per Share — net profit attributable to parent divided by shares outstanding.

en.sub: Data-driven priorities for the holding group.
items: Net profit halved YoY despite revenue growth; investigate cost inflation at MTWI and BPTR margin pressure.
D/E rose to 2.7x; review holding-level debt and dividend payout policy.
AUM stable at IDR 49tn; expand fund offerings and distribution channels.

id.sub: Prioritas berbasis data untuk grup induk.
items: Laba bersih turun separuh meski pendapatan tumbuh; telusuri inflasi biaya di MTWI dan tekanan margin BPTR.
D/E naik ke 2,7x; tinjau utang induk dan kebijakan dividen.
AUM stabil Rp49 triliun; perbanyak produk reksa dana dan saluran distribusi.

zh.sub: 基于数据的集团优先事项。
items: 收入增长但净利腰斩；排查MTWI成本上升和BPTR利润率压力。
D/E升至2.7x；审视母公司债务和分红政策。
AUM稳定在49万亿盾；丰富基金产品和分销渠道。

en.sub: Sector tailwinds for the three subsidiaries.
items: Low penetration vs ASEAN peers; growing retail investor base via digital platforms.
BPTR positioned as corporate fleet electrification partner.
MTWI can tap sharia-compliant insurance demand.
